name: Charges Record 8
definition: Provides further individual record details on the charges related to the payment transaction.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Transaction charges to be paid by the charge bearer.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the charges amount is a credit or a debit amount. |Usage: A zero amount is considered to be a credit.

ChargeIncludedIndicator.name: Charge Included Indicator
ChargeIncludedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the charge should be included in the amount or is added as pre-advice.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of the charge or fee.

Bearer.name: Bearer
Bearer.definition: Specifies which party/parties will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction.

Agent.name: Agent
Agent.definition: Agent that takes the transaction charges or to which the transaction charges are due.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Provides details on the tax applied to charges.
